hooks.command: cd $CWD && if git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -q 'supabase/functions'; then echo 'Edge Function changed — flag for MCP deploy_edge_function, never dashboard paste.'; fi

hooks.prompt: Check: did the tester subagent report a PASS verdict backed by real evidence (log lines or test output) for every change made this session? If not, or if only mocked-data tests ran on a change that touches live data, return {"decision": "block", "reason": "tester has not confirmed with evidence — hand off to tester before finishing"}. Otherwise return {"decision": "allow"}.
